task.title: Add, edit or delete your saved autofill info in Chrome
task.shortdesc: Learn how to add, edit, and delete existing autofill information in Chrome.

section.p: Note:If your payment method is saved in Google Wallet, you'll need to edit or delete it in Google Wallet.

step.cmd: Select the info that you want to update,
step.stepxmp: like payments, addresses or contact info.

steps.step: Under each category, you can turn Save and fill on or off. This allows you turn autofill off completely.

To add, edit or delete autofill information, follow the steps in the table:
Option
Description
Add
At the top right of the info type, select Add.
Some menus have additional options and info types to choose from.
Edit or Delete
To the right of the saved info, select More Edit or Delete.

p.p: If you add, edit or delete info and you're signed in to Chrome with your Google Account, your changes will also show up on your other devices where you're signed in to Chrome with the same account.
